stack: Elixir/Phoenix LiveView + React (esbuild) + Tailwind CSS + PostgreSQL + ClickHouse — premier Elixir de la boucle
bootPath: mix/phx local (pas docker compose officiel) — requis pour patcher assets/ React + templates HEEx depuis le SHA source
bootSteps: tools/boot.sh — BOOT_ROOT/REPO/APP_PORT/PG_PORT/CH_PORT/PG_NAME/CH_NAME paramétrables ; containers PG+CH (CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP=1 + CLICKHOUSE_DB obligatoires sinon auth requise), CONFIG_DIR secrets overrides, mix deps.get + ecto.create + ecto.migrate, npm ci assets+tracker, mix assets.build, npm run deploy --prefix tracker, mix download_country_database, tools/seed.sh, nohup mix phx.server
seedSteps: tools/seed.sh — mix run priv/repo/seeds.exs (NON idempotent : ne pas relancer sans reset DB) + INSERT shared_links SQL

auditCommands.baselineAuth: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8950 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-auth.txt) --states all --out reports/baseline-auth --storage-state tools/auth.json
auditCommands.baselinePublic: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8950 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-public.txt) --states none --out reports/baseline-public
auditCommands.finalAuth: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8950 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-auth.txt) --states all --out reports/final-auth --storage-state tools/auth.json
auditCommands.finalPublic: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8950 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-public.txt) --states none --out reports/final-public
auditCommands.installBuild: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8960 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-auth.txt) --states all --out reports/install-build --storage-state tools/auth.json
auditCommands.installPublic: node tools/audit.mjs http://localhost:8960 --urls $(paste -sd, tools/urls-public.txt) --states none --out reports/install-public
auditCommands.incompleteProbes: node tools/incomplete-probes.mjs http://localhost:8950 --storage-state tools/auth.json --reports reports/final-auth reports/final-public --out reports/incomplete-probes.json
